title: Quantitative Guidelines for Anonymity Assessment of Synthetic Health Checkup Data
summary: A research project developing quantitative safety and utility thresholds (DCR, TSTR, correlation delta) for judging when synthetic medical health-checkup data is sufficiently anonymous, comparing multiple generation tools including ARX, Synthpop, and MASQ. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, run via synthesis/sdv_generate.py, to generate one of the synthetic datasets evaluated against the proposed anonymity guidelines.
